title: Stream call audio to a WebSocket that checks a bearer token
summary: Send one side of a call, or both, to your own WebSocket over TLS, with a bearer token on the connection and your own metadata attached.
scenario: Your transcription service accepts connections only with a bearer token, and needs to know which ticket each stream belongs to

folds: round 7 gap: live-call control over REST
evidence: tools/openapi/rest.json Calling.CallRequest variant calling.stream: params required control_id and url; the url description says it must start with wss:// and that plain ws:// is rejected; track enum inbound_track|outbound_track|both_tracks; authorization_bearer_token is sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>; custom_parameters pass through as connection metadata; status_url with status_url_method GET|POST; codec is freeform
npm @signalwire/sdk 2.0.5 client.calling.stream / streamStop send the same bodies
